page.notes: Printed text is set in two-column-free single block; the paragraph marks "V." and "VI." are numbered theses and were transcribed as printed. Some words in the first paragraph are uncertain (e.g. "sceleraa" appears as printed with an extra letter, "ipsorum"). The final line "gumen-" is a catchword-like continuation at the foot of the text block and was kept in the text. Marginal mark at left edge of line 2 is a printer's mark, not transcribed.
